# Frequently asked questions

The questions we get most often. If yours isn't here, drop us a line at contact@rool.dev.

## Getting started

### What is a Rool Machine?

A Rool Machine is your own private computer in the cloud: a highly optimised Linux virtual machine running an operating system we built specifically to be operated by AI. Your files, notes, chats, and memories are all stored privately inside it, and the AI agent itself runs inside the VM, isolated from every other Machine. It's a real computer and an AI fused into one thing: private, available anywhere, and fully yours, with full export and API access.

### Where do my files and memories actually live? [...] ### Where do my files and memories actually live?

Inside your Rool Machine. Each Machine is a private Linux VM, and everything you create is stored inside it: files, notes, chats, Objects, and memories. The agent that works with you runs inside the same VM, so your work is isolated at the machine level, not just by an access rule. What's inside your Machine stays yours.

### Is Rool really free?

Yes. The Standard plan is free forever, with no credit card and no trial clock. You get 2 private Rool Machines with 1 GB of storage each, 1,000 AI credits that refill at 10 per hour (240 per day), full Object Memory, and the same frontier AI models as paid users. Upgrade to Pro (€25/month) when you outgrow it, or stay on the free plan indefinitely. [...] ### What does "persistent memory" actually mean?

Most AI chat tools forget everything between sessions, or compress old conversations into a small "memory" summary. Rool is different. Every chat, file, and idea becomes an Object that lives in your Rool Machine permanently. Your AI builds on real, structured data, not a fuzzy summary, and gets more useful over time as your knowledge graph grows.

### Can I invite other people into my Rool Machine?

Yes. A Rool Machine can be shared with collaborators. Everyone you invite works inside the same Machine, with the same files, memory, and AI.

# Rool Documentation

A Rool Machine is a private AI computer in the cloud: a virtual machine that holds Objects, files, conversations, and memory, with an AI agent running inside it. The AI operates on a structured world model — objects, schema, references, files — not just a text transcript.

Everything a Machine contains is accessible programmatically. These docs cover the developer tools for building on top of it.

> Naming note: the SDK predates the Rool Machine branding and calls a Machine a space (`createSpace`, `RoolSpace`, `/space/...` paths). The API will move to Machine terminology in v2; until then, read “space” as “Machine” throughout the API.

# Everything a computer can do, with a mind of its own.

Each Rool Machine is a private computer in the cloud, run by an intelligence that reads, writes, and works alongside you. Here's what that means in practice.

## A computer with a mind

Your Rool Machine is a highly optimised private Linux VM with a mind of its own. Your files, notes, chats, and memories are stored privately inside it. The AI runs inside it too, isolated from every other Machine, working on your things with you.

It isn't a chat app with memory. It isn't a cloud drive with chat. It's a single thing, available on any device, and yours.

## A memory that doesn't reset [...] ## A memory that doesn't reset

Every chat, file, and idea becomes an Object: a structured, durable unit your AI can read, link, and build on. Over weeks and months, your Machine becomes a knowledge graph of the people, projects, notes, and decisions that make up your work.

Most AI tools fall back on summaries when conversations get long. Rool doesn't. Your AI works directly with the real Objects, so context isn't compressed or lost.

The longer you use Rool, the more it knows about you, your work, and the way you like things done.

## Real work with real files

Upload, store, edit, and organise any kind of file: documents, images, spreadsheets, code, PDFs, audio, video. Your Rool Machine can read them, write new ones, and transform them on your behalf. [...] Convert a rough markdown note into a formatted report. Crop and resize a batch of images. Run calculations across a spreadsheet. Refactor a piece of code. The Machine has hands as well as a mind.

## Share the Machine, share the mind

Invite people into your Rool Machine and they work inside the same thing you do: the same files, the same memory, the same AI. AI agents can join too, operating on the same source of truth.

Real-time sync, full undo/redo history, persistent storage. No exporting to share. No reconciling versions. Everyone sees the Machine as it is, right now.

## Always on the best AI
